title: Beef project (BeefProj.toml)
description: Configuration of a Beef project, as written by the Beef IDE and read by BeefBuild. Keys are case sensitive.

FileVersion.description: Format version of the project file. BeefBuild writes 1.

Dependencies.description: Projects this project depends on, keyed by project name. corlib is an implicit dependency when this table is absent.

additionalProperties.description: A configuration (Debug, Release, Paranoid, Test, ...) keyed by platform name (Win32, Win64, Linux64, wasm32, ...).

ProjectFolder.description: Source folder tree. Omit it to use the default 'src' folder with automatic inclusion.

Dependencies.description: Map of dependency project name to a version requirement, a path or a git repository.

Dependency.description: A semver requirement string, { Path = "..." } or { Git = "...", Version = "..." }.

Path.description: Path to the project directory, relative to the directory of this file.

Git.description: Git repository URL to clone the dependency from.

Version.description: Branch, tag or commit to check out when Git is used.

Name.description: Project name. Defaults to the name of the project directory.

Version.description: Project version (semver), used when other projects depend on this one.

TargetType.description: Kind of binary this project produces.

StartupObject.description: Type that contains the entry point, without a namespace (for example "Program" or "MyApp.App").

DefaultNamespace.description: Default namespace used for files that do not declare one. Defaults to the sanitized project name.

Aliases.description: Aliases that identify this project when another project references it.

ProcessorMacros.description: Preprocessor macros defined for the whole project.

DistinctOptions.description: Build options that only apply to types matching a filter.

IconFile.description: Path to the .ico file embedded into the executable.

ManifestFile.description: Path to the application manifest embedded into the executable.

Description.description: File description shown in the executable properties.

Company.description: Company name shown in the executable properties.

Product.description: Product name shown in the executable properties.

Copyright.description: Copyright notice shown in the executable properties.

FileVersion.description: File version shown in the executable properties.

ProductVersion.description: Product version shown in the executable properties.

Options.description: Extra linker options passed when linking the Linux target.

ProjectOptions.description: Build, debug and compiler options for one configuration and platform.

TargetDirectory.description: Directory the build output is written to. Supports $(Configuration), $(Platform), $(BuildDir), $(ProjectDir), ...

TargetName.description: File name of the build output, without extension. Supports the same substitutions as TargetDirectory.

OtherLinkFlags.description: Extra flags passed to the linker.

CLibType.description: C runtime the target links against.

BeefLibType.description: Whether library targets are produced as static or dynamic Beef libraries.

StackSize.description: Stack size of the main thread in bytes. 0 uses the platform default.

BuildCommandsOnCompile.description: When the pre/post build and clean commands run for a compile.

BuildCommandsOnRun.description: When the pre/post build and clean commands run for a run or debug session.

PostBuildOnFailure.description: Run the post build commands even when the build failed.

LinkDependencies.description: Additional native libraries to link, as names passed to the linker.

PreBuildCmds.description: Commands executed before the build, in order.

PostBuildCmds.description: Commands executed after a successful build, in order.

CleanCmds.description: Commands executed when the project is cleaned.

DebugCommand.description: Program to launch for a debug session.

DebugCommandArguments.description: Command line arguments for the debugged program.

DebugWorkingDirectory.description: Working directory of the debugged program.

EnvironmentVars.description: Environment variables set for the debugged program, as NAME=value.

PreprocessorMacros.description: Preprocessor macros for this configuration and platform. DEBUG, RELEASE, PARANOID and TEST are defined by default.

RelocType.description: Relocation model of the produced binary.

SIMDSetting.description: SIMD instruction set the generated code may use.

DistinctOptions.description: Build options that only apply to types matching a filter.

COptions.description: Options for the C/C++ code generated by Beef.
Options for the C/C++ code generated by Beef. Only available when the IDE was built with C support.

CompilerType.description: Compiler used for the generated C/C++ code.

OtherCFlags.description: Extra flags passed when compiling generated C source.

OtherCPPFlags.description: Extra flags passed when compiling generated C++ source.

IncludePaths.description: Include paths for the generated C/C++ code.

EnableBeefInterop.description: Enable interop between Beef and the generated C/C++ code.

PreprocessorMacros.description: Preprocessor macros for the C/C++ compiler.

DisableExceptions.description: Compile the generated code without exceptions.

SIMD.description: SIMD instruction set used for the generated C/C++ code.

GenerateLLVMAsm.description: Also emit LLVM assembly for the generated code.

DisableInlining.description: Disable inlining in the generated code.

DisableRTTI.description: Compile the generated code without RTTI.

OptimizationLevel.description: Optimization level for the generated C/C++ code.

EmitDebugInfo.description: Emit debug information for the generated C/C++ code.

AddressSanitizer.description: Address sanitizer configuration passed to the C/C++ compiler.

AllWarnings.description: Enable all warnings for the generated C/C++ code.

SpecificWarningsAsErrors.description: Warnings that are treated as errors.

DistinctOptions.description: Build options that only apply to types matching a filter, for example Filter = "[System.Optimize]".

BfSIMDSetting.description: SIMD instruction set for the matching types.

BfOptimizationLevel.description: Optimization level for the matching types.

BfFloatingPointMode.description: Floating point mode for the matching types.

BfFMASetting.description: FMA setting for the matching types.

EmitDebugInfo.description: Debug information emitted for the matching types.

RuntimeChecks.description: Enable runtime checks (null, bounds, ...) for the matching types.

InitLocalVariables.description: Initialize local variables to zero for the matching types.

EmitDynamicCastCheck.description: Emit dynamic cast checks for the matching types.

EmitObjectAccessCheck.description: Emit object access checks for the matching types. Requires EnableObjectDebugFlags.

ArithmeticCheck.description: Emit arithmetic overflow checks for the matching types.

AllocStackTraceDepth.description: Stack trace depth recorded for allocations of the matching types.

ReflectAlwaysInclude.description: Reflection inclusion rule for the matching types.

ReflectBoxing.description: Include boxing methods of the matching types in reflection.

ReflectStaticFields.description: Include static fields of the matching types in reflection.

ReflectNonStaticFields.description: Include instance fields of the matching types in reflection.

ReflectStaticMethods.description: Include static methods of the matching types in reflection.

ReflectNonStaticMethods.description: Include instance methods of the matching types in reflection.

ReflectConstructors.description: Include constructors of the matching types in reflection.

ReflectMethodFilter.description: Method name filter for reflection inclusion.

Folder.description: A source folder. Folders can be nested through Items.

Type.description: Optional for the root folder, where it is ignored. Folders nested in Items declare their kind with Type.

Path.description: Path of the folder relative to the project directory.

Comment.description: Comment shown in the IDE project tree.

AutoInclude.description: Automatically include every file found in this folder.

Source.description: Source file names in this folder that are always included.

FolderItem.description: An explicitly listed file or folder within a source folder.

Type.description: Kind of item. AutoFolder and Folder are folders, Source and IgnoreSource are files.

enumValues: A single source file that is always compiled.
A file that is explicitly excluded from the build.
A folder whose files are listed explicitly.
A folder that is included automatically.
A folder that is excluded from the build.

Name.description: File or folder name. Defaults to the file name of Path.

Path.description: Path relative to the project directory. Defaults to the parent folder plus Name.

Comment.description: Comment shown in the IDE project tree.

AutoInclude.description: For folders: automatically include every file found in them.

Source.description: Source file names in this folder that are always included.
